{{Quote|We'll head for Tessen. Get you out from there.|Kawlan Roken, to a group of fugitives|audio=Roken-Tessen-KenobiVI.flac|<ref name="Part VI">{{Kenobi|Part VI}}</ref>}}
'''Tessen''' was a celestial body in<ref name="CLNE" /> the [[Tessen system]] of the [[Phelleem sector]]<ref name="Appendix" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="CLNE" /> and [[the Slice]]<ref name="Slice" /> that fell within grid square S-7 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="CLNE" /> It was part of the [[Salin Corridor]] [[hyperspace route]]<ref name="Salin" /> which connected it to the astronomical object [[Boonta]] and<ref name="CLNE" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Geektionary French">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' {{C|French version only}}</ref> [[Sy Myrth]].<ref name="CLNE" />

In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|V}}</ref> [[Imperial Military|Imperial Forces]] [[Hunt for the Hidden Path|tracked down]] a group of fugitives being protected by the [[Hidden Path]] on<ref name="KenobiV" /> the world<ref name="JabiimDB">{{Databank|jabiim|Jabiim}}</ref> [[Jabiim]]<ref name="KenobiV">{{Kenobi|Part V}}</ref>—which was also located in grid square S-7<ref name="CLNE" />—and [[Attack on Jabiim|forced]] them to flee offworld in a [[JT-731 Broadhorn transport]] without a functioning [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="KenobiV" /> While the [[transport]] was pursued by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'', the Hidden Path's leader, [[Kawlan Roken]], informed those on board that they would head for Tessen, where the Hidden Path would then get them to safety. The [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] then departed from the [[Starship|vessel]] alone in an [[Escape pod|escape craft]], drawing off the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] so that the transport could escape.<ref name="Part VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tessen was first mentioned in the [[Part VI|sixth episode]] of the live-action [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] [[Disney+]] series,<ref name="Part VI" /> which aired on [[June 22]], [[2022]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2022}}</ref>
